MINT AI

The app's own settings, on this computer. MINT AI's settings (voice, approvals, sessions) are on the site, in MINT AI ▸ Settings.

Where it lives

ModeFloating sits in a corner above every window; Peek stays hidden until you call it; Desktop layer lives on the wallpaper, under every window.
Focus modeJust the core; its colour and motion still say what it is doing.
MonitorPeek always opens where the mouse is.
Size, position, opacityRemembered per monitor. Size: the box's tools; position: drag the core (Floating) or pick below.

Hotkeys

Click a box, then press the keys. Ctrl or Alt plus one key. Esc (hide Peek, end a call) works while MINT AI has the focus.

Talk (hold)
Live conversation (start / end)
Show / hide
Focus mode

Ctrl+Space is "trigger suggestion" in VS Code and switches the input method on Chinese and Japanese keyboards; MINT AI takes it from every app while it runs. Ctrl+Alt+Space is the alternative.

Behaviour

Do not disturbNo Windows toasts; the amber tray dot stays.
Battery saverOn battery, with Windows' energy saver, or while a full-screen app runs, the core holds still.
Start with Windows
Check for updatesFrom os.mint-stack.com/desktop/, signed.

Experimental

Desktop layer behind the iconsUses undocumented Windows behaviour (live wallpapers use it; Windows updates have broken it). Behind the icons MINT AI cannot be clicked at all: talk with the hotkey, and use Ctrl+Alt+M to bring it up.

This computer

Link this computer to Mint OS so MINT AI can work on it when you ask it to. It never starts by itself: you hand over control from MINT AI, for a limited time, with a glowing frame round the screen the whole time. Stop it with the pill's Stop button or the stop key below.
